# ProFix & Shine

> Professional Cleaning, Painting & Exterior Maintenance Services in Luton, Bedfordshire & Surrounding Areas.

## Company Overview
ProFix & Shine is a top-rated local property maintenance, painting & decorating, exterior cleaning, pure water window cleaning, and high-pressure jet washing specialist based in Luton, Bedfordshire, UK. Fully insured with a 5-star rating across Luton and Dunstable.

## Core Services Offered
1. **Painting & Decorating** (https://www.profixandshine.co.uk/services/painting-decorating): High-grade interior and exterior painting, wall preparation, wood staining, and commercial decorating with 5-star precision.
2. **High Pressure Jet Wash** (https://www.profixandshine.co.uk/services/jet-wash): Commercial-grade pressure washing for driveways, block paving, patios, stone, and brickwork. Removes stubborn moss, algae, oil, and grime.
3. **Crystal Clear Window Cleaning** (https://www.profixandshine.co.uk/services/window-cleaning): 100% pure deionised water reach-and-wash system for streak-free windows, frames, and sills on residential & commercial properties.
4. **Garden & Ground Cleaning** (https://www.profixandshine.co.uk/services/garden-ground-cleaning): Complete garden clearance, hedge trimming, weed removal, leaf cleanup, and lawn maintenance.
